arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Jeffrey Sutton argued the state ban is a health-based prohibition.
He claimed this triggers federal preemption of state laws.
General Underwood argued the state rule is not preempted.
He stated the ban is not based on smoking and health.
